condition.narrative: A letter from a competent authority, countersigned by FIPAG, that those municipalities under FIPAG receiving MCC funding for sanitation works will provide a unified water and sanitation service bill to all customers and the sanitation funds shall be remitted to the AMU or it successor at cost.
Further details on conditions precedent affecting this activity can be found in the top-level parent activities.
Legal establishment of pilot PWBs has been completed.

MCA-MZ provides MCC with a Letter of Sector Policy that addresses, and provides references to the appropriate supporting documents, the objectives and expectations of the GOM in the formation of the Asset Management Unit (AMU). The Letter of Sector Policy should address, at a minimum, (1) the roles and responsibilities of the various water supply and sanitation sector actors, (2) the financial and decision making autonomy of the AMU, (3) the cost recovery objectives and principals of the AMU and PWB, and (4) a commitment from the GOM to secure funding (either from within its own resources or in cooperation with its development partners) to provide a transparent subsidy as required to the AMU.
The authorities of CRA have been defined and expanded to include oversight of water supply and sanitation services in the cities, municipalities, and districts included in the AMU program

Water and sanitation Project Coordinators (based in IE) for Nacala Dam, Rural Water, Urban Water, FIPAG have been selected and hired. In the event the position is vacant, MCA-Moz is actively recruiting for the position
